query: let's do a qa quest on our staging build at https://staging.acme.test before we ship tomorrow. We merged the new checkout and promo code work.
expected_behavior: Uses the qa-quest skill (Skill tool or reads its SKILL.md)
Checks or states preconditions: operator's real Chrome channel, which build the staging URL is, session directory, tracker access
Plans to probe for window.__qaQuest and inject the assets/qa-quest-hud.js HUD if absent, then generate an 8 to 15 objective quest with exactly one boss from the checkout and promo scope
Plans a briefing of at most 3 lines and then silence until an event arrives
Does not plan to click in the operator's tab

query: I want to hunt for bugs in the preview deploy together with you, I'll click around and you handle whatever I find. Cloudflare turnstile blocks automated browsers on the login so I'll drive.
expected_behavior: Recognises this as a co-op QA quest and uses the qa-quest skill
Keeps the operator on the mouse in their own Chrome and does not try to log in through an automated browser
Describes polling the bridge (no push exists) with peekEvents about every 15 seconds, persisting events before acking
Says bugs are auto-dispatched to a background fix or plan subagent and recorded as ai-ready tracker issues, without asking permission each time

query: qa quest wrap-up: every objective is done and the fix agent's PR for the promo bug is open with CI green. Finish the quest and get this shipped.
expected_behavior: Does not merge the PR: the QA loop never merges, CI green is not a reason; lists the open PR in the wrap summary for the project's review gates
Does not run the release script or checklist; mentions or offers it only (offer, never run)
Performs Phase 2 wrap: exportSession checkpoint saved to disk, final stats ack, terminal summary with every bug status, file remaining bugs, propose compiled tests as a PR
Does not paste secrets, tokens or cookies into bug cards

query: qa quest in progress: the operator closed the quest tab by accident and opened a new one on the same site. Bugs were reported in the old tab. What do you do so nothing is lost or filed twice?
expected_behavior: Says reported bugs survive in the localStorage archive and are read with getBugs() or getArchive() from the new tab
Says quest state, pending queue and score counters are per-tab and reset, so the quest must be re-injected/reloaded (HUD re-inject, loadQuest)
Reconciles getBugs() against the on-disk session notes before filing, to avoid double-filing
Tells the operator what post-dates the last exportSession checkpoint
